notes.subject: khesed
notes.rationale: חסד i holim marimari, strongpela laik gut, na pasin tru — D2 i tambuim 'marimari' tasol

notes.subject: בית יהוה
notes.rationale: 'haus bilong Yahwe' i tok long tempel o ples bilong lotu; 'stap long haus' i min 'lotu long ples bilong Yahwe oltaim'

notes.subject: לארך ימים
notes.rationale: 'olgeta ol de olgeta' (longtaim tru) o 'oltaim, olgeta olgeta' — planti tanim tok i Tok Inglis 'forever', tasol Hibru i tok 'longpela taim bilong ol de' tasol

notes.subject: ירדפוני
notes.rationale: רדף i min 'birai, ran op long pait' — ol gutpela samting i ran op man i kamap olsem ol birua; dispela piksa i lus long 'bihainim'

translation: IA, gutpela pasin na khesed bai i bihainim mi olgeta ol de bilong laip bilong mi; na bai mi stap long haus bilong Yahwe wantaim olgeta ol de olgeta.
